title: ContestTrade: A Multi-Agent Trading System Based on Internal Contest Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2508.00554v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In financial trading, large language model (LLM)-based agents demonstrate significant potential, but their decisions can be sensitive to noisy and non-stationary market information. We propose ContestTrade, a multi-agent trading system with an internal competitive mechanism inspired by institutional investment workflows. The system consists of two specialized teams: (1) a Data Team that processes and condenses massive market data into diversified textual factors optimized for constrained LLM context windows, and (2) a Research Team that produces parallelized multipath trading decisions via tool-augmented deep research. The core design is a "Quantify-Predict-Allocate" contest mechanism within each team: agent outputs are scored only after market outcomes become observable, future utility is predicted from historical scores, and resources are allocated to agents with positive predicted utility. translated_title: ContestTrade：一种基于内部竞赛机制的多智能体交易系统
translated_abstract: 在金融交易中，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体展现出显著潜力，但其决策可能对嘈杂且非平稳的市场信息敏感。我们提出了ContestTrade，一种受机构投资工作流程启发的、具有内部竞争机制的多智能体交易系统。该系统由两个专门团队组成：（1）数据团队，负责处理并压缩海量市场数据，将其转化为多样化的文本因子，以优化受限的LLM上下文窗口；（2）研究团队，通过工具增强的深度研究生成并行化的多路径交易决策。核心设计是每个团队内部的“量化-预测-分配”竞赛机制：智能体的输出仅在市场结果可观察后进行评分，未来效用根据历史得分进行预测，并将资源分配给具有正预测效用的智能体。在2024年后的A股回测中，Co...
tldr: ContestTrade通过引入内部竞赛机制和“量化-预测-分配”流程，有效提升了多智能体交易系统对嘈杂市场信息的适应性和决策质量。
en_tdlr: ContestTrade introduces an internal contest mechanism with a "Quantify-Predict-Allocate" process to enhance adaptability and decision quality of multi-agent trading systems in noisy market conditions.
